description: This file defines the PduBody class, which manages a collection of PduPart objects representing parts of a MIME message body. It provides methods for adding, removing, and retrieving parts, as well as indexing and mapping parts by various identifiers like content ID, content location, name, and filename. The class is part of an MMS (Multimedia Messaging Service) library for handling PDU (Protocol Data Units).

classes.name: PduBody
classes.description: Represents the body of a PDU message consisting of multiple parts, with mechanisms to add, remove, and access parts via different IDs and indices.

methods.name: addPart
methods.description: Appends a new PduPart to the body, updating internal maps for lookup. Throws NullPointerException if the part is null.

methods.name: addPart
methods.description: Inserts a PduPart at a specified position in the parts list, updating maps. Throws NullPointerException if the part is null.

methods.name: removePart
methods.description: Removes and returns the part at the specified index.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all parts from the body.

methods.name: getPart
methods.description: Retrieves the part at a specified index.

methods.name: getPartIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a specified part.

methods.name: getPartsNum
methods.description: Returns the total number of parts.

methods.name: getPartByContentId
methods.description: Retrieves a part by its content ID.

methods.name: getPartByContentLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a part by its content location.

methods.name: getPartByName
methods.description: Retrieves a part by its name.

methods.name: getPartByFileName
methods.description: Retrieves a part by its filename.
